scope: All source directories including vendor and sandbox; generated/import caches excluded. Script rows are candidate methods (including wiring and fixtures), not unique effects. Scenes/materials/animations are separate resources. Reviews are source coverage plus representative native QA, not a claim of individual rendered approval.
